correctness.rationale: TARGET headline with floored radius and downgrade algebra verified computationally (ARM_REGIME_OK, trivial/small-N covers, C finite). However Lemma 1 as written claims conditional opening probabilities coincide until touching dB and hence exact agreement outside B for FK q=2. For FK this is false: single-edge conditional given explored history integrates over unexplored region containing K, so graphs G vs G\K give different conditionals at first step; CBC gives domination not equality. The stated TV bound |gap|<=max(mu(F),mu^K(F)) therefore lacks proof; standard disagreement-cluster coupling is not cited/proved. H1 exponent 3/8 uniformity (sup over b.c., centre, isoradial honeycomb) is not literally the published statement: DCHN11/Chelkak-DCH prove uniform RSW and exact exponents on Z^2, Wu gives SLE-derived exponents; 3/8 slack must be derived from exact 1/2 via u^{1/2}<=u^{3/8}, not assumed as black box. Corner m<=6 inclusion F=>half-arm up to c0^{-6} is sketched without proof of geometric containment for quarter-annulus at walls. Lattice d1=max(d,1) flooring correctly repairs d=0 normalization (literal (d/N)^{1/4}=0 would be false for single site). Central coupling gap is material, so correctness FAILS as written.
